context: Ren and Sho-young try out a new puzzle game together.
purpose: Mentor and child solving puzzle together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 蓮にいちゃん、パズル、難しい!
lines.en: Ren, this puzzle is really hard!
lines.style: Soft, genuine frustration. Not crying, but at the edge of giving up. Seeks help from someone he trusts. Open, vulnerable delivery — no performance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Using your brain is the fun part.
lines.style: Patient, unhurried. Gentle reassurance delivered as fact, not pep talk. Slight warmth on 楽しい — inviting Sho into the pleasure of the struggle, not dismissing his complaint.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft, tentative. Real uncertainty — he's checking with Ren, not announcing. Hopeful but ready to be wrong. The voice of a child thinking out loud with someone safe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Bright, genuine affirmation. Quick and assured. The warmth of an older person who means what he says and loves being right when it matters. No condescension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, proud burst. Energy rising. The joy of progress shared. Ren is included in the 'we' without having to ask. Small boy triumph.
